# Sparrow Collect

> Sparrow Collect is an AI-powered mobile app (iOS & Android) that scans, identifies, and values collectibles across 54 categories. It pulls real-time pricing from leading marketplaces — eBay, TCGPlayer, StockX, Cardmarket, and Discogs — so collectors can track portfolio value, compare prices, set watchlist alerts, and decide when to buy or sell. One app for trading cards, figures, vinyl, watches, LEGO, sneakers, comics, and more.

## What it does

- **Scan & identify**: Point your camera at an item; AI identifies it and extracts structured attributes (brand, set, edition, condition).
- **Value**: Real-time market valuations with low/median/high price quantiles, sourced from live marketplace data and normalized to your currency.
- **Track**: Build a collection portfolio and watch its total value change over time.
- **Alerts**: Set watchlist price alerts and get notified on market moves.
- **Deal Hub**: Surface buying opportunities across marketplaces against your interests.

## Pricing

- **Free**: Download and track your collection with core features.
- **Sparrow Pro — €4.99/month or €39.99/year**: Unlimited items, AI scans, market alerts, and advanced valuations.
